title: Reconcile legacy copied-primitive guidance with the live Factory contract
content: Several intake tool headers and STD-INTAKE-PRIMITIVES-001 describe distributed copies under ADR-014, while current FACTORY.md requires one live Factory. Define the governing path and update stale headers before Product developers copy universal tools.
evidence: docs/FACTORY_INTAKE_REVIEW.md lists inspected sources and blob hashes; FACTORY.md sections 3, 6 and 7 versus email_core.py/doc_extract.py headers.

title: Publish a hosted-runtime extraction contract separate from development governance
content: A hosted Product must operate without a sibling Factory checkout. Define a reviewed versioned package or service contract for reusable extraction primitives, including provenance, licenses, explicit config, capability reporting and update policy. Do not copy Factory governance or unify Product-specific intake pipelines.
evidence: docs/FACTORY_INTAKE_REVIEW.md; doc_extract.py discovers config via cwd/parent walking and optional imports, while Email Brain needs a tenant-scoped service worker.

title: Require sandbox budgets and redacted outcomes for hostile-document extraction
content: Specify process/container memory, CPU, wall-time, output-size, no-network, read-only input, archive expansion and antivirus gates. TOOL_MISSING and TIMEOUT must remain explicit outcomes, not empty successful text. Standardize canary and adversarial fixtures across Products.
evidence: docs/FACTORY_INTAKE_REVIEW.md contrasts archive_unpack.py budget safeguards and doc_extract.py optional-import/error behavior with an unattended multi-tenant service.

title: Separate sender familiarity from authenticated authority
content: A trusted_sender allowlist is a routing hint. Require provider-supplied authentication evidence and explicit user intent for privileged operations; From-header matches must never authorize actions, secrets disclosure, or cross-Product exports.
evidence: trusted_sender.py exact/domain matching reviewed 2026-09-19; Email Brain SECURITY.md threat model and server-bound authorization.

title: Clarify retained evidence versus disposable intake carriers
content: For evidentiary systems, ABSORB/empty-intake rules should preserve governed source evidence and clear only the drop-zone. Deleting a mailbox source or attachment requires a distinct retention/purge authorization and a verified recovery policy.
evidence: STD-INTAKE-MODEL-001 ABSORB verify-delete language versus Email Brain evidence/version/provenance requirements in ADR-014.
